(NASDAQ: CHKP), a pioneer and global leader of cyber security solutions, today announced that the Check Point Platform for Government has achieved GovRAMP Authorization, providing state, local and tribal agencies assurance that its prevention-first cyber security solutions meet GovRAMP’s rigorous requirements. After achieving FedRAMP in 2025, GovRAMP extends Check Point’s certification to all levels of government across the United States.
